```{r}
# packages for plotting
```

# Functions

To reduce code, we will generate some functions here. 
```{r, echo = F}
# function, to get the frequency of all genes, that can be found two or more times in the data sets
get_frequencies <- function(genes) {
  genes_freq <- as.data.frame(table(genes))
  names(genes_freq) <- c("Gene", "Freq")
  genes_freq <- genes_freq[order(genes_freq$Freq, decreasing = T), ]
  return(genes_freq)
}

# function, to get all genes, which exon eQTL SNPs are overlapping with a GWAS SNP
GetOverlaps <- function(gwas, genes, snps, category){
  res <- data.frame(Gene = "", Category = "")
  # check for each gene and each state if there is any overlap
  for (gene in genes) {
    if(sum(overlapsAny(snps[snps$gene_name == gene, ], gwas)) > 0){
      gene_gwas <- cbind(gene, category)
      colnames(gene_gwas) <- c("Gene", "Category")
      res <- rbind(res, gene_gwas)
    }
  }
  res <- res[res$Gene != "", ]  # remove empty first row
  return(res)
}

# function to load the PRS all score file, change the colnames into right order and return only IID and 0.01 PRS
GetPRS <- function(filename){
  all_scores <- suppressWarnings(fread(filename, stringsAsFactors = F))
  # set colnames right 
  names <- colnames(all_scores)[-1] # remove first colname and save all others
  all_scores$`1` <- NULL # remove last column with NAs
  colnames(all_scores) <- names # set right colnames
  # return only IID and PRS for 0.01
  score <- all_scores[, c("IID", "0.01")]
  return(score)  
}
```


# Load data

## Load Index and Overlap data

Here, we will load all necessary data files. Following files will be loaded:
1. Rare variants of index patients including all columns,
2. ABMS exon eQTS genes (gene symbol and Ensembl gene ID),
3. exon eQTL Genes (eeGenes, gene symbol and Ensembl gene ID) and
4. overlap genes of rare variants, ABMS eeQTS and eeGenes (gene symbol and Ensembl gene ID). 
```{r}
# 1. Rare variants of index patients
index <- readRDS(paste0(rdata_path, "/Index-patients_rare_variants_filtered.rds"))
# 2. ABMS eeQTS
eeqts <- fread(paste0(overlap_path, "/1_ABMS_eQTS_genes.txt"), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
# 3. eeGenes
eegenes <- fread(paste0(overlap_path, "/2_exon_eQTL_genes.txt"), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
# 4. Overlap
overlap <- fread(paste0(overlap_path, "/4_overlap_eeGenes_ABMS_rare.txt"), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
```

Then, we will check the number of found index-patient genes:

|      | Counts |
|------|------|
| Index (Mutations) | `r length(index$"Ensembl Gene ID")` |
| Index (Genes) | `r length(unique(index$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` |


# Overlaps to other resources

Before, we can do the overlaps, we need to remove the endings from the Ensembl gene IDs from the eGenes.
```{r, echo = F}
# for all eGenes remove endings from the Ensembl Gene IDs for the overlap to CMC
geGenes <- unique(as.vector(sapply(unlist(strsplit(eqtls_gene$`Ensembl Gene ID`, "\\|")), function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])))
length(geGenes)
teGenes <- unique(as.vector(sapply(unlist(strsplit(eqtls_transcript$`Ensembl Gene ID`, "\\|")), function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])))
length(teGenes)
eeGenes <- unique(as.vector(sapply(unlist(strsplit(eqtls_exon$`Ensembl Gene ID`, "\\|")), function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])))
length(eeGenes)
```

Now, we can check all the overlaps to the index dataset:

|      | Index |
|------|------|
| tDEGenes | `r length(intersect(tDEGenes$"Ensembl Gene ID", index$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` |
| eDEGenes | `r length(intersect(eDEGenes$"Ensembl Gene ID", index$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` (`r round(length(intersect(eDEGenes$"Ensembl Gene ID", index$"Ensembl Gene ID")) / (length(index$"Ensembl Gene ID") / 100), digits = 2)`%) |

| teGenes | `r length(intersect(teGenes, index$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` (`r round(length(intersect(teGenes, index$"Ensembl Gene ID")) / (length(index$"Ensembl Gene ID") / 100), digits = 2)`%) |
| eeGenes | `r length(intersect(eeGenes, index$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` (`r round(length(intersect(eeGenes, index$"Ensembl Gene ID")) / (length(index$"Ensembl Gene ID") / 100), digits = 2)`%) |

# Figures

## Rare variants of index patients dataset

### Barplot of variants per patient

```{r, echo = F}
# And we will plot the rare variants frequency:
# get frequency for each gene ID
index_new <- as.data.table(index)[, c("PatientID", "Ensembl.Gene.ID")]
index_freq <- get_frequencies(index_new$Ensembl.Gene.ID)

# Generate barplot
pdf(file = paste0(out_path, "/1_barplot_rare_variants_index-patients_gene_counts.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
barplot(table(index_freq$Freq), xlab = "Frequency", ylab = "# genes with this frequency", col = "black", cex.axis = 1.5, lwd = 2, cex.names = 1.5, cex.lab = 2, cex.main = 2)
dev.off()
barplot(table(index_freq$Freq), xlab = "Frequency", ylab = "# genes with this frequency", col = "black", cex.axis = 1.5, lwd = 2, cex.names = 1.5, cex.lab = 2, cex.main = 2)
```

## Barplot of FUMA results

First we need to load the dataset and filter it for FDR < 0.05:
```{r, echo = F}
# Load FUMA GS file for the rare variants of index patients
index_fuma <-fread(paste0(fuma_path, "/3.2_rare_variants_index/GS.txt"), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
index_fuma <- index_fuma[index_fuma$Category == "3_kegg_entrez_no_disease_pathways.txt", ]
index_fuma <- index_fuma[index_fuma$adjP < 0.05, ]
print(paste0("Significant gene sets for geGenes (cases and controls): ", dim(index_fuma)[[1]][1]))

index_fuma$log_adjP <- -log10(index_fuma$adjP)
index_fuma$GeneSet <- factor(index_fuma$GeneSet, levels = index_fuma$GeneSet[order(index_fuma$log_adjP)])

# Generate barplot
g <- ggplot(index_fuma, aes(y = log_adjP, x = GeneSet)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    ylab(bquote("-log"["10"]*"(adjP)")) +
    xlab("") +
    ggtitle("Index: KEGG pathways") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.01)) +
    theme(axis.ticks = element_line(colour = NA), text = element_text(size = 16), panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA), panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey"), panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(colour = "grey"), strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA))
ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(out_path, "/1_barplot_rare_variants_index-patients_top_KEGG_pathways.pdf"), width = 11, height = 12)
g
dev.off()
```


# Overlap dataset

## VENN diagram of Overlap

```{r, echo = F}
#############################
### Generate VENN diagram ###
#############################
pdf(paste0(out_path, "/2_VENN_diagram_overlap_eeGenes_ABMS_index.pdf"))
grid.newpage()
overrideTriple=T
test <- draw.triple.venn(area1 = length(unique(eeGenes)), area2 = length(unique(abms$V1)),
                         area3 = length(unique(index_new$Ensembl.Gene.ID)), lty = "blank",  
                         n12 = length(intersect(eeGenes, abms$V1)), 
                         n23 = length(intersect(abms$V1, index_new$Ensembl.Gene.ID)), 
                         n13 = length(intersect(eeGenes, index_new$Ensembl.Gene.ID)),            
                         n123 = length(intersect(eeGenes, intersect(abms$V1, index_new$Ensembl.Gene.ID))),
                         category = c(paste("eeGenes", length(unique(eeGenes)), sep = "\n"), 
                                      paste("ABMS eQTS", length(unique(abms$V1)), sep = "\n"), 
                                      paste("Index", length(unique(index_new$Ensembl.Gene.ID)), sep = "\n")),
                         fill = viridis(3))
grid.draw(test)
dev.off()
```

## Barplot of FUMA results

First we need to load the dataset and filter it for FDR < 0.05:

## Heatplot of top pathway genes

First, we need to get the genes of the top pathways.
```{r, echo = F}
kegg_genes <- overlap_fuma[, c("GeneSet", "genes")]
kegg_genes <- separate_rows(kegg_genes, genes, sep = ":")
genes <- unique(kegg_genes[kegg_genes$GeneSet %in% c("ECM-receptor interaction", "Focal adhesion"), ]$genes)
length(genes)
```

Then, we will generate the dataset, which we need to generate the heatplot. Therefore, we need three columns, with column 1 including the gene name and column 2 the ID or type the gene is found in, e.g. the pathway, eeGenes, etc.
```{r, echo = F}
# We will start with the three pathways:
```

Get the eQTL SNPs for the 28 hit genes:
```{r, echo = F}
# get SNPs per gene from exon eQTL hits
genes_eesnps <- eqtls_exon[eqtls_exon$`Gene Symbol` %in% genes, c("SNP", "SNP Location", "Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol")]
genes_eesnps <- genes_eesnps[!duplicated(genes_eesnps), ]  # remove duplicated rows
genes_eesnps$CHR <- unlist(lapply(genes_eesnps$`SNP Location`, function(x) strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1]))
genes_eesnps$POS <- unlist(lapply(genes_eesnps$`SNP Location`, function(x) strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2]))
# generate GRanges object
genes_eesnps_gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(seqnames = genes_eesnps$CHR, 
                                           ranges = IRanges::IRanges(start = as.numeric(as.character(genes_eesnps$POS)), 
                                                                     end = as.numeric(as.character(genes_eesnps$POS))),
                                           snp_id = genes_eesnps$SNP, 
                                           gene_id = genes_eesnps$`Ensembl Gene ID`,
                                           gene_name = genes_eesnps$`Gene Symbol`)
# remove duplicates
genes_eesnps_gr <- genes_eesnps_gr[!duplicated(genes_eesnps_gr)] 
GenomeInfoDb::seqlevelsStyle(genes_eesnps_gr) <- "NCBI"
# get table how many SNPs we have for each gene
table(genes_eesnps_gr$gene_name)
rm(genes_eesnps)
```

Add VEP hits:
```{r, echo = F}
# load VEP
vep <- readRDS(paste0(rds_path, "/VEP_hg19_collapsed_MAF01.rds"))
states <- c("synonymous_variant_d", "stop_gained_d", "splice_region_variant_d", "promoter_d", "missense_variant_d", "3_prime_UTR_variant_d", "5_prime_UTR_variant_d")
# check for each gene and each state if there is any overlap
for (gene in genes) {
  for (state in states) {
    vep_selected <- vep[vep$code == state]
    if(sum(overlapsAny(genes_eesnps_gr[genes_eesnps_gr$gene_name == gene, ], vep_selected)) > 0){
      gene_vep <- cbind(gene, strsplit(state, "_d$")[[1]][1])
      colnames(gene_vep) <- c("Gene", "Category")
      plotting_data <- rbind(plotting_data, gene_vep)
    }
  }
}
```

Add ChromHMM hits:
```{r, echo = F}
# load ChromHMM
chromhmm <- readRDS(paste0(rds_path, "/ChromHMM_all_Brains.rds"))
states <- c("1_TssA", "2_TssAFlnk", "3_TxFlnk", "4_Tx", "5_TxWk", "6_EnhG", "7_Enh", "8_ZNF/Rpts", "10_TssBiv", "11_BivFlnk", "13_ReprPC")
# check for each gene and each state if there is any overlap => if yes, save it
for (gene in genes) {
  for (state in states) {
    chromhmm_selected <- chromhmm[chromhmm$name == state]
    if(sum(overlapsAny(genes_eesnps_gr[genes_eesnps_gr$gene_name == gene, ], chromhmm_selected)) > 0){
      gene_chromhmm <- cbind(gene, strsplit(state, "_")[[1]][2])
      colnames(gene_chromhmm) <- c("Gene", "Category")
      plotting_data <- rbind(plotting_data, gene_chromhmm)
    }
  }
}
```

Finally, we can generate the heatplot using ggplot:
```{r, echo = F}
# order plotting data on category and genes with most hits
#plotting_data$Category <- factor(plotting_data$Category, levels = names(table(plotting_data$Category)[order(table(plotting_data$Category), decreasing = T)]))
plotting_data$Gene <- factor(plotting_data$Gene, levels = names(table(plotting_data$Gene)[order(table(plotting_data$Gene), decreasing = T)]))
#plotting_data$Category <- factor(plotting_data$Category, levels = c("ECM-receptor interaction", "Focal adhesion", "ABC transporters", "Rare variants", "Joint eeQTS", "MDD eeQTS", "SCZ eeQTS", "eeGenes", "teGenes", "geGenes", "eDEGenes", "GWAS Catalog SCZ-related", "CMC g/isoDEGene"))
g <- ggplot(plotting_data, aes_(~Gene, ~Category)) +
  geom_tile(aes(width = 0.9, height = 0.9), color = "white") + 
  xlab(NULL) + 
  ylab(NULL) + 
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", angle = 60, hjust = 1), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) + 
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0.02, 0)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.03, 0)) 
ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(out_path, "/2_heatplot_overlap_eeGenes_ABMS_index_top_KEGG_pathway_genes.pdf"), width = 8, height = 9)
g
dev.off()
```

```{r, echo = F}
# load SCZ2-2014 PRS

colnames(pData(exon_summaries))[length(pData(exon_summaries)[1,])] <- "PRS.SCZ2"
```

## Boxplot

Generate a boxplot for the LAMA4 exon eQTL of the expression of exon ENSE00000762309 with SNP rs11373481:
```{r, echo = F}
# get exon expression
exon_expr <- t(t(exprs(exon_summaries)[grep("ENSE00000762309.1", rownames(exon_summaries)), ]))
colnames(exon_expr) <- "ENSE00000762309.1"

# snp data
system(paste0("/storage/groups/ccm01/tools/PLINK/plink --bfile /storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/05.eQTLs/01_preprocessed_genotypes/1.3_samples_filtered/pmb_info06_all_chr_maf0.05_merged --snp rs11373481 --recode --tab --out LAMA4_SNPs"))
snp <- read.delim("LAMA4_SNPs.ped", head = T)
pheno <- pData(exon_summaries)[, c("IID","Dx", "ShortName")]

exp_p <- merge(exon_expr, pheno, by.x = "row.names", by.y = "ShortName")
exp_p_snp <- merge(exp_p, snp, by.x = "IID", by.y = "X2.1")
save(exp_p_snp, file = paste0(out_path, "/LAMA4_ENSE00000762309_expression_vs_rs11373481_snp.rda"))

# Generate plot
plot_data <- melt(exp_p_snp, snp = "C.C", measure.vars = c("ENSE00000762309.1", grep("ENS", colnames(exp_p_snp), value = T)))
plot_data <- plot_data[plot_data$C.C != "0 0",]
plot_data$variable <- as.character(plot_data$variable)
# plot figure
pdf(paste0(out_path, "/4_boxplot_LAMA4_ENSE00000762309_expression_vs_SNP_rs11373481.pdf"), width = 6, height = 5)
ggplot(na.omit(plot_data), aes(C.C, value)) +
  geom_boxplot() + geom_jitter(shape = 16, position = position_jitter(0.1)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 12), axis.text = element_text(size = 9), 
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16), 
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20), strip.background = element_rect(
     color = "black", fill = viridis(3, option = "D", begin = 0.15, end = 0.9)[2], size = 1.5, linetype = "solid"
     ), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
     panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black")) +
  xlab("rs11373481") + ylab("Exon expression") + ggtitle("LAMA4: ENSE00000762309 - rs11373481")
dev.off()
ggplot(na.omit(plot_data), aes(C.C, value)) +
  geom_boxplot() + geom_jitter(shape = 16, position = position_jitter(0.1)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 12), axis.text = element_text(size = 9), 
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16), 
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20), strip.background = element_rect(
     color = "black", fill = viridis(3, option = "D", begin = 0.15, end = 0.9)[2], size = 1.5, linetype = "solid"
     ), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
     panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black")) +
  xlab("rs11373481") + ylab("Exon expression") + ggtitle("LAMA4: ENSE00000762309 - rs11373481")
```
